messages:
noah_cs: quick outbound draft for affected onboarding customers. keeping it short: what happened, impact, mitigation, timeline, credits, RSVP. please review.

lee_eng: root cause: a deployment changed queue-shard routing at ~02:50 UTC causing partial worker starvation. rolled back at 03:05 UTC and started backfill. throughput ~88% now. estimate full catch-up 4-7h. incident INC-2026-58600.

noah_cs: draft message below — edit for tone/accuracy: 

noah_cs: ```Hi <Customer>,
We	apologize for the disruption. Earlier this morning (~02:50 UTC) an internal configuration change briefly affected our onboarding ingestion pipeline, delaying processing of some uploads and trial imports. We reverted the change and triggered a backfill; processing is underway and we expect full catch-up within 4	6	hours.

Why this happened: queue-shard routing was misapplied which throttled part of the worker pool (INC-2026-58600).
What we did: rolled back the change, temporarily increased backfill worker capacity by 3x, patched the shard routing logic, and are monitoring until caught-up.
Impact: no data loss; search/embeddings completeness will return once backfill completes.
Next steps: we	re hosting one office hour today at 16:00 UTC (RSVP link). We	re offering a one-time onboarding credit up to $250 for affected trial/onboarding windows. If you	re in a renewal window or want prioritized assistance, reply and we,ll schedule a 30-minute review with Solutions Engineering and your AE.
Thanks for your patience — Noah, Customer Success```

maria_legal: legal approves "one-time onboarding credit up to $250" language. please include a short clause: "credits applied at company's discretion" and link to T&Cs.

carmen_se: I can lead the office hour and capture blockers. will attach a 1-page checklist for customers to run beforehand.

status_bot: INC-2026-58600 status: RESOLVED (rollback + backfill). public status: https://redwood.status/incidents/INC-2026-58600 :white_check_mark:

noah_cs: final checklist before send: 1) add T&C link 2) RSVP + calendar invite 3) append renewal flag list 4) AE/SEP ping. target send 09:00 UTC. will post final copy here for a last check.
